thread:
emily_kwan: Heads-up: NimbusGrid listing + AmpereX hardware bundle goes live in two weeks. We need partner-facing escalation playbook: SEV mapping, shared channels, phone/pager, and an on-call rota for the launch window.
raj_patel: Good call. We should make a single source runbook that both NimbusGrid and AmpereX can access. Suggest naming: partner-runbook/<partner>-escalation.
lisa_ops: Also propose a 24/7 emergency phone tree for SEV1 and an on-call Slack bridge for SEV1/SEV2. For SEV3 just async via shared channel.
tom_hardware: AmpereX asks for direct SRE contact when their hardware telemetry shows node failures. They want 30-min acknowledgement SLA for SEV1.
mike_si: Our systems integrator (SI) team will need an integration lead in the channel too. We typically map: Redwood SEV1 = P1 (service down), SEV2 = P2 (severe perf/regressions), SEV3 = P3 (minor impact). Do we want different names for partners?
emily_kwan: Keep Redwood naming but include partner equivalents in mapping. Also define who can declare a SEV1 (partner on-call + Redwood SRE lead).
raj_patel: Draft escalation matrix: Tier 1: Partner SE / SI (ack + initial triage); Tier 2: Redwood SRE (deep triage + mitigation); Tier 3: Eng oncall + HW vendor SME. Include phone escalation: call -> SMS -> pager.
lisa_ops: Create shared channels per vendor: #partner-nimbusgrid-support and #partner-amperex-ops. Access policy: partner accounts + Redwood SE + SRE. No public messages without comms/legal signoff.
tom_hardware: AmpereX wants hardware vendor SMEs in the AmpereX channel and a separate telemetry webhook. We can add webhook to #partner-amperex-ops with read-only post perms.
ops_bot: War room created: #warroom-nimbus-amperex-launch by emily_kwan. Link: https://warrooms.redwood.internal/xyz789
emily_kwan: Nice. Mike, can SI provide their on-call roster and escalation numbers? We need phone numbers, primary/backup, and timezone availability.
mike_si: Sending roster in DM now. Will post sanitized contact list to #partner-nimbusgrid-support once channel exists. Also recommend a 2-hour window for joint status copy approvals during launch.
raj_patel: I'll produce the partner-runbook WIP and include: SEV definitions, escalation matrix, contact list template, war-room template, and a tabletop checklist. Link will go to docs.redwood.com/partnerships/nimbus-amperex-runbook (WIP).
lisa_ops: Assign action items: RAJ (runbook draft), MIKE (SI roster), TOM (AmpereX SME list + telemetry webhook spec), EMILY (create channels + invite partners), LISA (schedule tabletop + legal/comms loop).
emily_kwan: Scheduling tabletop for tomorrow 11:00 PT. Please join if assigned. If anything else, post here and I'll consolidate before we share with partners. :calendar:
